title: World Trail Majors — all races 2026
claims: World Trail Majors lists the Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler on 2026/11/05-08 as one of its ten 2026 races.

WTM describes the GPT100 Miler as a newly-established world-class Grampians Peaks Trail that is 98% single-track, traversing the Gariwerd/Grampians range from Mt Zero in the north to Dunkeld in the south.

The other nine 2026 World Trail Majors races are Hong Kong 100 (2026/01/22-25), Black Canyon Ultras (2026/02/14-15), Transgrancanaria (2026/03/04-08), Mt. FUJI 100 (2026/04/24-26), MIUT (2026/04/25-26), South Downs Way 100 (2026/06/13-14), Quebec Mega Trail (2026/07/02-05), Vietnam Mountain Marathon (2026/09/17-20) and RMB Ultra-Trail Cape Town (2026/11/20-22).

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接抓取 worldtrailmajors.com/all-races/，读取十站列表与 GPT100 简介。
